test_title: PYST 106: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 12 Jan, 2023 Shift 4).
subject: reasoning
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown having symbols- @, Δ, ▭, $, ∞, ↑. Find the symbol on the face opposite the face showing '∞'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9545265523427aae84d695dfaba2b3da5819c57813ff4eac66ef182338dee73.png]
solution:
As '$' and '@' are the common face on both the dice, '∞' face is opposite to '↑'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e72f4305d5e6ae1002984c8672fcfb478039b3d6f201f3738b97a8689d0ffc3f.png] 

Hence, ‘↑’ is the correct answer.
